name: My Melody & Kuromi
description: When My Melody's visit to the Cloud Kingdom leads to a whirlwind of trouble, can she, Kuromi and their friends save their home before it's too late?

videos.title: What's This? My Heart Is Pounding
videos.overview: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.

videos.title: Fluffy and Soft
videos.overview: Up in the clouds, My Melody has an ominous encounter with a giant, fluffy bear. Back in Mariland, Flat encourages her to join the upcoming sweets contest.

videos.title: Kuromi's Great Recipe Heist
videos.overview: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.

videos.title: Honey Car Chase!
videos.overview: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.

videos.title: The Sweets Contest Begins
videos.overview: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?

videos.title: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki
videos.overview: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...

videos.title: What Should I Do?
videos.overview: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.

videos.title: Time for Teamwork
videos.overview: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.

videos.title: To the Cloud Kingdom!
videos.overview: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.

videos.title: Pistachio's Past
videos.overview: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.

videos.title: All for Our Best Friend
videos.overview: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.

videos.title: My Melody & Kuromi
videos.overview: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?
